sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Video Game Kernel-Level Anti-Cheat and Integrity Middleware

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier (CMF), Articles L561-1 to L561-50 (AML/CFT obligations); Décret n°2018-1056 of 30 November 2018 (UBO register); Article L561-2-2 CMF (declaration of beneficial owners); Code de commerce (Articles L232-3, R232-3 et seq. for company registers).

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of valid passport of each UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notaire Public / Consular Post in country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address (recent utility bill or bank reference) for each UBO and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Local municipal authority or licensed bank

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of incorporation and good standing of any corporate parent entity
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent Registry of Commerce in parent jurisdiction

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories against the French national sanctions list (Direction générale du Trésor), OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and UN Security Council Consolidated List; PEP classification under CMF Art. L561-10; continuous monitoring required.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Guichet Unique des Formalités des Entreprises (formulaires.entreprises.gouv.fr); name availability check via INPI data (data.inpi.fr)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All legal names must be in Latin script with French transliteration required for non-Latin originals; no foreign language tokens are permitted except where commercially established; the SAS name must be followed by either 'SAS' or the full legal form where applicable.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A rejected name application may be refiled after modification, or appealed by a written administrative appeal to the Registrar (Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce) within 15 days; further judicial recourse is available in the Tribunal judiciaire; advisory opinion may be sought from INPI.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for low-risk SAS via a licensed domiciliation provider (société de domiciliation) under Code de commerce Art. L123-10; the provider must be approved and a contract filed; physical substance is not mandatory for this industry, but a genuine office location must be declared.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 5% - unannounced on-site inspections are rare for non-regulated low-risk technology companies, limited to fraud or AML suspicion.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Legal and consultancy fees for drafting the articles of association (statuts) and conducting pre-incorporation due diligence
Notarization and apostille fees for UBO identity and supporting documents
Company registry filing fees (greffe fees) for SAS incorporation
Publication of incorporation announcement in a legal notice journal (annonce légale)
UBO declaration and AML/CFT compliance review fees
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Compliance consultant

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Annual domiciliation contract (virtual office) – first year
INPI corporate name availability and trademark pre-search
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI)

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Code de commerce (France), Articles L.210-1 to L.210-9 (commercial companies), Articles L.227-1 to L.227-20 and R.227-1 to R.227-14 (Société par Actions Simplifiée), Articles L.232-1 et seq. (accounts), Article R.123-1 et seq. (RCS registration) and Article L.225-3 principles extended by practice to SAS cash contributions.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS), administered by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, with filings processed through the Guichet Unique des Entreprises operated by INPI (Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle), which also transmits to INSEE (SIREN/SIRET), URSSAF and the DGFiP.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Dossier de création d'entreprise / constitution de société (single-window incorporation dossier) comprising the 'statuts constitutifs', attested copy of the 'attestation de dépôt des fonds', 'déclaration de non-condamnation', proof of legal notice publication, and beneficial-owner declaration ('déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs'); the resulting title of registration is the 'Extrait Kbis'.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The SAS has no statutory minimum share capital (Article L.227-2 of the Code de commerce); capital is freely fixed in the statuts. Subscription may be in cash or in kind (in-kind contributions valued by a 'commissaire aux apports' where value exceeds EUR 30,000 and exceeds half of the share capital). Cash contributions must be deposited in a blocked escrow account ('compte séquestre' / 'compte bloqué') with a credit institution, notary or avocat, evidenced by an 'attestation de dépôt des fonds'; funds are released to the company only after RCS registration. Shares are fully paid up at issuance in standard practice; a minimum of 50% paid-up on subscription applies only where the statuts adopt the SA-style rule.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST RESOLUTION OF THE FOUNDING SHAREHOLDERS AND FIRST BOARD MEETING — RESOLVED: (1) that the shares subscribed pursuant to the statuts constitutifs are hereby approved and entered in the share register; (2) that the registered office is fixed at [address], France; (3) that [Name] is appointed Président for an indefinite term and [Name] as Directeur Général; (4) that the Président is authorised to open the corporate bank account, publish the legal notice, complete the Guichet Unique filing and execute all deeds necessary for incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of the Statuts Constitutifs
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Private instrument executed before the founding shareholders; notarial authentication optional (Notaire) but required where in-kind contributions are not valued by a commissaire aux apports.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the 'statuts constitutifs' of the SAS containing: corporate name (followed by 'SAS'), registered office, corporate purpose covering ISIC 6201 activity, share capital and share classes, subscription and payment terms, governance (Président, optional Directeur Général, optional Comité stratégique in lieu of a board), decision-making thresholds, duration, and dissolution terms. Where in-kind contributions exceed EUR 30,000 and half of the capital, appoint a 'commissaire aux apports' (Article L.225-8 / R.225-6). Sign in as many originals as required, append the 'annexe' listing subscribers and subscribed shares, and complete the 'déclaration de non-condamnation' for each manager on the CERFA form 15783.
required_dossiers: Statuts constitutifs signed by all shareholders
Annexe: subscription list and share allocation
Extrait Kbis or identity documents of corporate shareholders; ID and proof of address of individual shareholders and managers
Déclaration de non-condamnation et filiation (CERFA 15783) for the Président and any Directeur Général
Commissaire aux apports report (Article L.225-8) where in-kind contributions exceed thresholds
Proof of residence for each managing officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Guichet Unique rejects the statuts for formal defects, execute a 'statuts modifiés' rectifying the non-conforming clauses and file an amended dossier; missing officer declarations are cured by re-executing the CERFA without reopening the incorporation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit of Cash Capital into a Blocked Escrow Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Commercial bank, notary (Notaire) or avocat holding the 'compte séquestre' / 'compte bloqué'.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a blocked escrow account in the name of the 'société en formation' with a French credit institution. Wire or deposit the subscribed cash consideration in euros. Obtain the 'attestation de dépôt des fonds' dated and signed by the depositary, stating the amount of funds blocked and the identity of the subscribers. Keep the attestation for inclusion in the Guichet Unique dossier; funds are released only upon presentation of the Extrait Kbis. No capital movement may occur before registration.
required_dossiers: Attestation de dépôt des fonds (original, dated)
Bank identification statement of the escrow account
Proof of transfer for each cash contribution
Signed statuts constitutifs (copy supplied to the depositary)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the institution refuses the escrow, deposit the funds with a notaire or avocat acting as séquestre; where the amount is transferred late, issue a corrected attestation stating the actual date of deposit without amending the capital amount.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the Legal Notice (Annonce Légale)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Journal d'Annonces Légales (JAL) authorised in the department of the registered office, listed by the Ministère de la Justice; publication confirmed through the INPI's 'Annonces du Guichet Unique' service.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Publish a legal notice containing the mandatory particulars: corporate name, legal form, share capital, registered office, corporate purpose, duration, and the name, title and address of the Président. Select a JAL authorised for the department of the registered office. Obtain and retain the 'attestation de parution' with the publication date and the JAL's registration number; the notice must be published before or no later than the date of filing with the Guichet Unique.
required_dossiers: Draft annonce légale text
Signed statuts constitutifs (extract used for notice)
Attestation de parution issued by the journal d'annonces légales
Proof of payment of publication fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL is not authorised for the relevant department, republish in a compliant journal and file both attestations with a corrigendum note; material errors require a corrective publication before RCS submission to avoid a registration refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Single-Window Filing via the Guichet Unique (INPI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique des Entreprises — INPI, accessible at procedures.inpi.fr; the transaction is routed to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce, INSEE, URSSAF and the DGFiP.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Create a Mandataire account on procedures.inpi.fr (or file through a notaire or expert-comptable mandataire). Complete the 'Constitution de société' form, attach the machine-readable statuts (signed PDF), the attestation de dépôt des fonds, the attestation de parution, the déclaration de non-condamnation, the déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs, and the 'Formulaire M0' corporate identity data. Electronically sign and submit. Monitor the dossier status; respond to any INPI 'demande d'information' within the stated window. On completion, the file transmits to the RCS greffe, INSEE and tax authorities.
required_dossiers: Statuts constitutifs (full signed PDF)
Attestation de dépôt des fonds
Attestation de parution de l'annonce légale
Déclaration de non-condamnation et filiation of the Président and Directeur Général
Déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs (RBE)
Formulaire M0 and M2 for each officer
Lease agreement, domiciliation contract or proof of title for the registered office
Proof of identity and, for foreign shareholders, a certified translation of corporate documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a rejection is issued, correct the identified defect and resubmit within the online dialogue; for technical failure of the Guichet Unique, file a paper dossier directly with the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce competent for the registered office as an emergency route.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: RCS Registration, SIREN/SIRET Allocation and Legal Personality
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (RCS register) and INSEE (SIRENE directory); tax registration by the Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: On validation, the company is inscribed in the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés and acquires legal personality from the date of registration. Obtain the Extrait Kbis (immatriculation number, SIREN 9 digits, SIRET, APE/NAF code 6201Z), activate the URSSAF employer account, receive the VAT identification number from the SIE, and release the escrowed funds by presenting the Kbis to the depositary. Confirm the SIRENE entry and verify the APE code aligns with the gaming anti-cheat middleware activity.
required_dossiers: Extrait Kbis (issued after registration)
SIREN/SIRET notification from INSEE
URSSAF account identification letter
VAT number confirmation (DGFiP)
Updated share register and minute book
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the APE code is incorrect, file a 'demande de modification' via the Guichet Unique to amend the activity code to 6201Z; if funds remain blocked, present the Kbis to the depositary and issue a formal release instruction letter.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Governance and Ongoing Compliance Setup
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: RCS / Guichet Unique (RBE and filings), DGFiP, URSSAF and the Ordre des Experts-Comptables where a commissaire aux comptes is appointed.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the definitive corporate bank account and migrate the escrowed funds. File or update the registre des bénéficiaires effectifs with the RCS within 15 days of any change. Adopt accounting policies compliant with the Plan Comptable Général, appoint a commissaire aux comptes where statutory thresholds are crossed, open the corporate books, and adopt internal governance minutes (board resolutions, delegation of powers, share register). Register for the DSF filing obligation and schedule the first annual accounts approval within six months of the financial year-end.
required_dossiers: Corporate bank account opening package
Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs filing receipt
First board and shareholder minutes
Registre des titres nominatifs (share register)
Accounting and tax registration confirmations
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the RBE declaration is filed late or incompletely, submit a corrected declaration with a rectification notice; where the bank delays account opening, obtain a written confirmation of the account in formation to preserve contractual currency flows.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: No industrial licensing board is competent: game engine software development under ISIC 6201 constitutes a tertiary/digital activity. Any residual facility-related oversight falls to the DREAL (Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement) and, for public-access premises, to the Commission de Sécurité of the department and the SDIS (Service Départemental d'Incendie et de Secours).
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None required — no 'autorisation d'exploitation' or manufacturing permit applies. The only facility-level authorisations potentially applicable are the 'autorisation de construire' / 'permis de construire' (Code de l'urbanisme, Article L.421-1) and the fire-safety clearance for an 'Établissement Recevant du Public' or 'Établissement Recevant des Travailleurs'.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: DREAL (Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement) under the Ministère de la Transition Écologique et de la Cohésion des Territoires; electronic filing via the INERIS / SIDE 'Guichet Unique Numérique' for ICPE authorisations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Non classé — the activity does not appear in the ICPE nomenclature annexed to Article R.511-9 of the Code de l'environnement. No systematic EIA ('étude d'impact') under Articles L.122-1 and R.122-2 applies to software development in office or data-centre tenancy. Data-centre hosting is assessed only indirectly through the landlord's ICPE authorisation (typically rubrique 1430 or 2925 for gensets and cooling installations).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial discharge thresholds apply. Residual obligations: ordinary waste management under Articles L.541-1 to L.541-4-4 of the Code de l'environnement; WEEE registration with ADEME (Décret n° 2005-829) and RoHS/REACH conformity (EU Directive 2011/65/EU; Regulation (EC) 1907/2006) where hardware devices are placed on the market; building-level discharge consents governed by the local 'règlement d'assainissement' and confined to sanitary wastewater. VOC thresholds under Arrêté du 2 février 1998 are not triggered.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire-safety and structural compliance: premises subject to the 'règlement de sécurité contre les risques d'incendie et de panique' (Arrêté du 25 juin 1980 for ERP; Arrêté du 31 décembre 1980 for ERT); a fire-safety certification or 'avis favorable' from the Commission Centrale/Départementale de Sécurité is mandatory for public-access premises; structural load inspections are required for server-room installations and any modification to load-bearing elements under the Code de la construction et de l'habitation (Article L.112-1 et seq.). Workplace clearance: the employer must maintain a 'Document Unique d'Évaluation des Risques Professionnels' (DUERP, Article R.4121-1 of the Code du travail), affiliate all employees to a Service de Prévention et de Santé au Travail (SPST), organise statutory training on electrical and ergonomic hazards, and comply with the Registre de Sécurité and evacuation-drill obligations (Articles R.4227-28 to R.4227-39).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction générale des Finances publiques (DGFiP), principally through the competent Service des impôts des entreprises (SIE). Tax and VAT services are accessed through impots.gouv.fr; company formation is registered through the national formalities portal, formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Register the SAS through the national business-formalities portal to obtain its SIREN and SIRET identifiers. The competent SIE assigns or confirms the corporate income tax account and, where required, the French VAT number, generally in the format FR plus a two-character key and the nine-digit SIREN. A foreign entity making taxable supplies in France must apply to the DGFiP for VAT registration before the relevant transactions; an entity established outside the EU generally appoints a French fiscal representative unless an applicable exemption or mutual-assistance arrangement applies. EU-established entities are generally not required to appoint one. Registration does not itself establish that a transaction is taxable or that VAT is recoverable.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: A SAS is generally subject to French corporate income tax (impôt sur les sociétés). An eligible qualifying SAS may elect temporary taxation under the personal income-tax regime for up to five fiscal years, subject to statutory ownership, activity, age, size, and shareholder-consent conditions. The election is not a US-style check-the-box election; France has no general entity-classification election equivalent to the US rules. No general hybrid-mismatch election changes the SAS's classification.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT; taxe sur la valeur ajoutée, TVA)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No general domestic turnover threshold applies to a French-established SAS required to charge VAT on taxable transactions. The French small-business VAT exemption (franchise en base) may apply below statutory turnover limits, which vary by activity and are subject to current-year rules; it does not apply as a general registration threshold to non-established taxable persons. Cross-border EU distance sales and certain electronically supplied services are subject to separate rules, including the EU-wide EUR 10,000 threshold for specified intra-EU B2C sales.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France is implementing mandatory domestic B2B e-invoicing and transaction/payment e-reporting through approved platforms (plateformes de dématérialisation partenaires, PDP), with data transmission to the tax administration. The statutory rollout begins on 1 September 2026: all in-scope businesses must be able to receive electronic invoices from that date; issuance obligations apply from that date to large companies and intermediate-sized enterprises and from 1 September 2027 to SMEs and micro-enterprises. The regime is not a general real-time pre-clearance or digital-stamping system. Applicable format, platform, transmission, and e-reporting requirements depend on transaction and taxpayer category; public-sector invoicing is subject to separate Chorus Pro requirements.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods from France to destinations outside the EU may be exempt from French VAT with a right to deduct input VAT when statutory conditions are met and the supplier can substantiate that the goods left the EU. The supplier must retain a valid export declaration and evidence of exit, together with the invoice and transport or commercial records. Services are not zero-rated merely because the customer or payment is offshore: treatment depends on the place-of-supply rules, customer status, service category, and any applicable exemption. B2B services supplied to a taxable customer established outside France are generally outside French VAT under the general place-of-supply rule, subject to exceptions.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Export declaration and customs exit confirmation, ordinarily evidenced by the export MRN and electronic exit result
Sales invoice and records identifying the goods, purchaser, destination, and export transaction
Transport evidence appropriate to the shipment, such as a bill of lading, air waybill, CMR consignment note, or carrier proof of delivery
Commercial and accounting records supporting the transaction and the link between the goods supplied and the goods exported
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: France imposes no general statutory deadline requiring export proceeds to be repatriated within 180 days. DGFiP may deny the export exemption or recover VAT where export or transaction conditions are not substantiated, with interest and applicable penalties. Late-payment interest is generally 0.20% per month. Tax increases may include 10% for specified filing failures, 40% for deliberate non-compliance, and 80% in cases such as fraudulent activity or abuse of law, subject to statutory conditions and procedural safeguards. False customs declarations may also attract separate customs penalties.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (as the national central bank and foreign exchange authority) and European Central Bank (for eurozone monetary policy coordination)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France maintains a fully convertible currency regime for both capital and current accounts under EU free movement of capital rules and post-1990 liberalization. The euro is freely convertible with no prior approval required for most cross-border transactions. Capital account convertibility is unrestricted for legitimate corporate purposes including equity injections, intercompany loans, and profit remittances. Current account transactions such as trade settlements are similarly liberalized. Profit remittance to non-resident shareholders is permitted without restriction for EU-established entities, subject only to standard corporate tax withholding (12.8% plus social charges) and potential CFC rules if the recipient jurisdiction applies preferential taxation. All transactions exceeding €10,000 trigger mandatory statistical reporting via the Banque de France 'M' report for monetary and balance-of-payments purposes. No capital controls or exchange restrictions apply to gaming-related treasury flows.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender or forced conversion of export proceeds is required under French law. Export receipts must be declared to customs authorities and recorded in corporate accounting systems for tax and statistical compliance. Companies may repatriate funds through normal banking channels without statutory timeline or conversion ratio mandates. Failure to declare may result in tax penalties or customs fines, but voluntary surrender is not enforced. For statistical reporting purposes, exports above applicable thresholds require the 'M' report submission to the Banque de France. Gaming anti-cheat engine settlements qualify as standard commercial exports with no additional surrender obligations.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High feasibility for fintech EMI cross-border viability using licensed e-money institutions such as Stripe, PayPal, or Adyen, subject to strict AML/KYC compliance and authorization under French e-money regulations (Directive 2009/110/EC). Offshore digital EMIs are permitted but require local licensing or partnerships with French banks for full integration. Legal constraints include registration with ACPR (Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution) and adherence to strict consumer protection rules. Gaming anti-cheat settlements can route through these rails with appropriate treasury controls.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence of directors is generally required for initial KYC interviews and account opening at tier-1 commercial banks in France. Remote opening is permitted only for smaller accounts or via digital platforms with video verification, but for cross-border treasury operations involving significant volumes, in-person interviews at bank branches are mandatory to comply with anti-money laundering directives and French banking regulations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions screening hits or adverse media on beneficial owners
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Comprehensive KYC dossier including beneficial ownership certificates, source of funds proof, and legal opinions confirming no sanctions exposure

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction connections or PEP status
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced due diligence reports, independent verification of ownership structure, and ongoing monitoring agreements with banks

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections via SWIFT MT103 wires with purpose code 'CAP' or 'EQTY' for equity contributions. Verification requires supporting documentation such as board resolutions, shareholder agreements, and tax ID verification. All wires must reference the recipient's IBAN and include full beneficial owner details to comply with French banking regulations and FATF standards. Gaming-related equity injections from EU or approved jurisdictions are processed without restriction.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements cleared via SWIFT MT103 for international payments and Commercial Letters of Credit (LC) under UCP 600 rules. For gaming-related settlements, payments to suppliers or partners must include detailed invoices and contracts. French banks facilitate these through correspondent networks in major financial centers. Anti-cheat engine service disbursements qualify as standard commercial trade flows.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Non-Deliverable Forwards (NDFs) for major currency pairs
Options on FX for asymmetric risk protection

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory accounts deposit (Dépôt des comptes annuels) after shareholder approval
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Registre National des Entreprises (INPI)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholder approval within 6 months of fiscal-year close; accounts filed with the trade registry within 1 month of approval (online filing within 30 days).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fines up to €10,000, court-ordered periodic penalty payments (astreinte), and administrative strike-off risk from the RCS for repeated non-filing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax and social solidarity contribution return (Liasse fiscale: 2065-SD and supporting schedule)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DGFiP – Service des Impôts des Entreprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For fiscal year ending 31 December: by the second working day following 1 May. For off-calendar fiscal years: within 27 days of the fiscal-year close.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty equal to 10% of net corporate tax due plus monthly late-payment interest of 0.40%; after formal notice, penalty rises to 40% and reassessment can be made.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial-owner confirmation and update of the UBO declaration (Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / INPI
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Any change in beneficial ownership must be filed within 30 days; at each annual accounts deposit the UBO declaration is confirmed and updated if share transfers occurred.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal fine up to €75,000 for the legal entity and €15,000 for individuals; up to 2 years imprisonment for intentional concealment; voting rights may be suspended.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate register audit, minutes book review, and register consistency check
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: President of the SAS and shareholders; statutory auditor (if appointed) during annual mandate
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Immediately before shareholder approval of annual accounts; registers, minutes, share transfer records and UBO register must be reconciled as of the meeting date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Civil liability of the president and director of record for defective registers; invalid corporate decisions may be annulled if minutes and ownership records are incomplete.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) is mandatory for a French SAS when at least two of the following thresholds are exceeded: balance-sheet total €4,000,000; net turnover €8,000,000; average workforce of 50 employees. Appointment may also be required by shareholder request or by group-control provisions.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Statutory accounts must be prepared under French GAAP in accordance with ANC Règlement n°2014-03 / Plan Comptable Général as updated. Consolidated accounts, if applicable, may be prepared under IFRS as endorsed by EU Regulation 1606/2002.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No separate annual UBO form is required if no ownership change occurred; at each annual accounts filing the current beneficial-owner declaration is reviewed and confirmed. Any transfer of shares or change in effective control requires a filing with the RCS within 30 days. All movements must be recorded in the share register, and the revised ownership schedule must be presented with the annual declaration.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% (standard rate; reduced 15% on first €42,500 of profit for SMEs with turnover < €10M)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Research Tax Credit (CIR) up to 30% of eligible R&D expenses; Innovation Tax Credit (CII) for SMEs; Reduced rate for innovative companies (JEI) with full exemption for first 3 years and 50% for next 2 years; Social surcharge of 3.3% on CIT above €763,000 for large companies

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 2065 (main corporate income tax return) and accompanying schedules (e.g., 2031, 2053) filed electronically via impots.gouv.fr
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: For fiscal year ending December 31, deadline is the second business day after May 1st; for other fiscal year-ends, within 3 months of year-end

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company identification (name, SIREN, address, legal form)
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide French tax representative details if non-resident without permanent establishment
Report only French-source income attributable to a permanent establishment
Claim CIR only for R&D activities performed in France
Apply reduced rate if SME criteria met; otherwise standard rate

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty: 5% of tax due, plus 0.4% per month of delay (max 10%); late payment interest at 0.2% per month; additional penalties for fraudulent filing

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 25% (reduced to 12% for EU parent companies under Parent-Subsidiary Directive if conditions met)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim treaty relief, submit Form 5000 (residence certificate) and Form 5001 (application for reduced withholding) to the French tax authorities; provide Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) from the recipient's jurisdiction; apply before payment or within the statutory deadline for refund
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory 33.33%, reduced to 0% under EU Interest & Royalties Directive (if beneficial owner and 25% shareholding); Interest: statutory 30%, reduced to 0% under EU Directive or treaty rates (e.g., 0% with many treaties)

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Local File and Master File required if group consolidated turnover exceeds €400 million; simplified documentation for companies with turnover < €400 million
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France applies substance-over-form and General Anti-Abuse Rule (GAAR); no specific ESR but requires real economic activity for tax residency and treaty benefits; anti-hybrid rules apply

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate understatement of income, false deductions, or concealment of assets
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Fine up to 40% of evaded tax (80% for abuse of rights), plus interest; criminal penalties up to €500,000 and 5 years imprisonment
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be held jointly liable for corporate tax debts if they participated in fraudulent acts; travel bans and asset freezes possible

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Lack of economic substance, artificial arrangements, or misuse of corporate form to avoid tax
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reclassification of transactions, denial of treaty benefits, 80% penalty for abuse of law, and potential criminal charges
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be personally liable for unpaid taxes and penalties; possible ban on managing companies

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to implement AML procedures, suspicious transaction reporting, or KYC compliance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative fines up to €5 million or 5% of turnover; criminal penalties for money laundering up to 5 years imprisonment and €375,000 fine
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may face personal fines and imprisonment if knowingly involved; professional disqualification

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to maintain TP documentation or applying non-arm's length prices
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Adjustment of taxable profits, 40% penalty on understated profits, and interest; potential double taxation
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors can be held liable for penalties if they knowingly approved non-compliant pricing; criminal liability in cases of fraud
